evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' with 'entirely' carries high-arousal urgency to purge — a directive performed with alarm-level insistence, not calm instruction.
'Remove all knowledge' is an absolutist purge directive performed with urgent, high-arousal insistence — the speaker's felt state is activated-negative, not neutral.
Flat declarative correcting a premise — low-arousal, negative valence: resigned dismissal delivered as settled fact, no urgency.
